nb790530987.headline: How Mergers Will Affect Customers in the Era of Digital Banking
nb790530987.summary: The mergers of Bankia with CaixaBank and Unicaja with Liberbank will raise market concentration in Spanish banking, though fintechs and neobanks are expected to provide competitive counterbalance.
nb790530987.why: Banking sector consolidation affects competition, customer choice, and financial stability, while fintech growth reshapes the industry landscape.

impacts.name: CaixaBank
impacts.why: Merger increases market share and concentration.
